description: We’re building a web tool for “Be An Earth System Trend Detective!” using NASA data (MERRA-2, GPM, MODIS). It maps regional trends over time and shows what is changing, where, how much, and whether it’s statistically significant, with plain-language summaries. Looking for teammates in data/statistics (Python), Earth science, UI design, and presentation. We’re students from Karachi working remotely. Beginners welcome!
